lines.trans: What an interesting question you have!
Well, let's suppose that money exists.
And where are they hidden?
Wait. Is our conversation being recorded?
Of course, everything is recorded on camera.
And why does this money interest you?
I am interested in your personal honesty.
Do you want to be together with me?
Yes, I want that very much.
Then tell me only the truth.
Honesty is the foundation of good relationships.
Alright. I will tell you the whole truth.
